CLAUDE LINK  ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

  The claude command starts Claude Code through switchboard, so every session is routed.

  ✓  Link                 ~/.local/share/switchboard/bin/claude → switchboard

  !  Your shell           runs Claude Code's own claude, ~/.local/bin/claude, so its sessions aren't routed

                ╭─ ADD A LINE TO ~/.zshrc ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
                │                                                                                                                              │
                │   Setup can add one line to the end of ~/.zshrc, so your shell finds switchboard's claude first:                             │
                │                                                                                                                              │
                │     if [ -r "$HOME/.local/share/switchboard/shell/init.zsh" ]; then . "$HOME/.local/share/switchboard/shell/init.zsh"; fi    │
                │     # switchboard                                                                                                            │
                │                                                                                                                              │
                │   The line hands off to a file of switchboard's own, which puts its claude first and loads its completions.                  │
                │   It does nothing once switchboard is gone, and nothing else in ~/.zshrc changes.                                            │
